# IPTV Norway One

> IPTV Norway One sells IPTV subscriptions with Norwegian and Nordic channels in HD to households in Norway. Ordering, payment and installation help happen on WhatsApp. The site is available in Norwegian (/) and English (/en/).

## Facts

- Price (1 screen): €15.99 for 1 month, €30.99 for 3 months, €45.99 for 6 months, €69.99 for 12 months (€5.83/month). Krone amounts are guidance at about 11.7 NOK per euro
- Screens: 1, 2 or 3 screens at the same time. 2 screens: €23.99, €49.99, €69.99 or €119.99. 3 screens: €32.99, €69.99, €94.99 or €169.99 (1, 3, 6 or 12 months)
- Contract: None. The subscription does not renew automatically
- Channels: Norwegian channels plus Sweden, Denmark and Finland. The line-up can change over time
- Picture: HD, and 4K where the channel broadcasts in 4K
- Devices: Samsung and LG Smart TV, Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV Stick, Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows, Mac and MAG box
- Internet speed: At least 10 Mbit/s per screen for HD, 25 Mbit/s for 4K
- Ordering and support: Via WhatsApp, in English and Norwegian
- Payment: Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal; from other EU countries also SEPA, iDEAL, Bancontact, giropay

## Guides (en)

- [Best IPTV provider in Norway – what to look for in 2026](https://iptvnorwayone.com/en/guides/best-iptv-provider/): The best IPTV provider for Norway delivers Norwegian and Nordic channels in HD, works on Smart TVs, phones and streaming sticks, and costs from EUR 15.99 per month for one screen. IPTV Norway One offers flexible plans with 1, 2 or 3 simultaneous screens, and subscription lengths from 1 to 12 months with no contract and no automatic renewal. You order and get support through WhatsApp in Norwegian or English.
- [IPTV providers in Norway: what to look for in 2026](https://iptvnorwayone.com/en/guides/iptv-providers/): IPTV providers stream live TV channels from Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland over the internet to your devices. The right one depends on how many screens your household uses at the same time, which countries you need, and whether support is available in Norwegian. IPTV Norway One offers flexible plans from one to three screens with no contract.
- [Chromecast IPTV: how to watch live channels on your TV in 2026](https://iptvnorwayone.com/en/guides/chromecast-iptv/): Chromecast IPTV works on Chromecast with Google TV, which lets you install IPTV apps from the Google Play Store. Install an IPTV app, enter your login details, and you can watch live Norwegian and Nordic channels directly on your television. Older Chromecast models without Google TV cannot install apps, but can cast from an Android phone.
